scope: CPU-only read-only audit of retained stage20 raw crops; no annotations, AP evaluation or alpha search

sources.binding: full database hashes match completed22, per-prediction hashes match18/20 frozen indices, raw NPZ digest matches20 raw_sha256

raw.rectangles: exact insertion-order union of800 and1280 crop plans

replay.mapping: float64 decoded clipped normalized cxcywh to exact native crop xyxy
replay.exact_ties: stable original candidate order; global rows first, then ordered crops and query order
replay.NMS: class-wise greedy, suppress IoU strictly >0.7, final global cap1000
replay.success: all1610 images in each of3 methods exactly reproduce frozen detection lists

subsets: retained crop candidates with scaled score >=0.05
geometry.ratio: decoded box area / originating crop area
geometry.examples: per-image top12 by area ratio then score, independently for all-retained and display-filtered; combine to global top40 each
geometry.claim: crop-filling boxes are descriptive geometry, not automatic false positives or proof of artefacts

alpha_readiness: true only after complete raw hash/shape/geometry audit and exact alpha=.25 replay of3 frozen methods; no AP-alpha curve computed by this tool

operation.resume: signature-bound per-image transactional SQLite cache; completed images reused after source identity checks
